title: guideUnits
responsibility: Checks committed named unit states against authored tests and verified device captures; reports inferred boundaries separately as advisory guesses.

inputs.name: guideUnits.id
inputs.description: Active unit ID in the loaded unit catalog. It selects the active entity whose named states, authored tests, and retained captures are checked.

inputs.name: guideUnits.options
inputs.description: Optional project root and extra required-state file paths forwarded to guidanceContext. If omitted, guideUnits passes its default empty object; the root otherwise resolves to process.cwd().

inputs.name: renderUnitsGuide.report
inputs.description: Structured report already produced by guideUnits. The renderer formats it without loading repository state or changing its proof fields.

commands: ${EDITOR:-vi} 'tests/e2e/component-catalog.spec.ts' # Write/extend "default" for workflow.development-tooling-guide-units, then commit the test.

proof.gap: No attached Harness verification evidence at this revision.

outputs.name: guideUnits
outputs.description: Resolved report for the selected active unit at HEAD, containing required states, authored tests, per-device capture status, advisory guesses, summary counts, proof gap, and any next commands. A required state is DONE only if an authored test is found and usable passed screenshots exist for desktop, tablet, and mobile; inferred guesses do not block completion.

commands: ${EDITOR:-vi} 'tests/e2e/component-catalog.spec.ts' # Write/extend "default" for workflow.development-tooling-guide-units, then commit the test.

proof.gap: No attached Harness verification evidence at this revision.

outputs.name: renderUnitsGuide
outputs.description: Human-readable string built from the report entity and commit, required-state rows, completion counts, proof gap when present, next-step commands or all-done note, and advisory guesses when present. It formats supplied data without recomputing guide results.
examples:
workflow.development-tooling-guide-units @ 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
REQUIRED = named unit states; guesses are advisory and do not block DONE.
MISSING default [REQUIRED] test:MISSING desktop:MISSING tablet:MISSING mobile:MISSING
  Default presentation.
0/1 DONE.
Proof: No attached Harness verification evidence at this revision.
NEXT: default
${EDITOR:-vi} 'tests/e2e/component-catalog.spec.ts' # Write/extend "default" for workflow.development-tooling-guide-units, then commit the test.
harness verify run --priority agent-test --entity workflow.development-tooling-guide-units
harness units guide workflow.development-tooling-guide-units
GUESSES (advisory; declare a catalog state if justified):
  ? empty-id: Prop guideUnits.id (string).
  ? without-options: Prop guideUnits.options (GuidanceOptions).
  ? with-options: Prop guideUnits.options (GuidanceOptions).
  ? failed: Contract mentions failed.
  ? passed: Source branch/type in src/workflows/development-tooling/guide-units/guideUnits.ts.
  ? DONE: Source branch/type in src/workflows/development-tooling/guide-units/guideUnits.types.ts.
  ? MISSING: Source branch/type in src/workflows/development-tooling/guide-units/guideUnits.types.ts.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: The async operation can reject while opening HEAD, loading unit data or required-state registries, resolving the active unit, reading source or test files, deriving test attribution, or validating retained captures; an unknown or inactive ID also fails lookup.
